title: 第29集 第13章 孟川和孟御第29集 第12章 通过考验
lines: “好好渡劫吧，渡过第八次天劫，你的寿命也将大大增加，也能看到精彩千倍万倍的风景。”千手师兄咧嘴道，“否则只能活在短短数十万年时间段内，又只经历一座宇宙，见识未免太少了。”
孟川倒不觉得，七劫境已经站在一座宇宙的巅峰，得到的够多了。
只是相比较而言，跳出时空长河的八劫境，所经历的匪夷所思而已。
“你考验已完成，不能在这逗留太久，该离开了。”千手师兄说道，“将来要拜见师尊，直接前往青火山即可。”
“千手师兄，那我告辞了。”孟川说道。
千手师兄点点头。
孟川的身体便消散不见。
千手师兄这才眉飞色舞，“这乾源山，又只有我一个了，碍事的都走光了。”
千手师兄美滋滋的就地一躺，六只爪子抱着自己，两只爪子摸着自己的脸，又开始睡起来，梦境中自然营造他想要经历的世界。作为拥有八劫境极限实力的千手师兄，梦境营造的世界，足以媲美真实世界。
漫长岁月，他早就习惯了在一个个梦境世界中‘为所欲为’，只有偶尔要接待师尊弟子时，才苏醒一次。
沧元界，天地大殿内，孟川的眉心也有火焰印记，一个念头，印记便隐藏起来。
远在乾源山的元神分身，说散也就散了，毕竟那一尊元神分身并没有什么宝物，在乾源山获得的天赋、记忆，家乡宇宙的真身分身也尽皆获得，没必要再辛辛苦苦赶路了。
“渡劫之前，还剩下二十年。”孟川走出天地大殿，“如今所有分身都回到家乡宇宙，控制自身时间流速，还可以守护家乡两百年。”
看似和旁人一样，可孟川自身经历的时间流速是外界十分之一。
如此，家乡宇宙的两百年后，天劫才会降临。
孟川也只是想，守护家乡，陪陪家人更久一些。
元初山高空，孟川俯瞰整个宗派。
经过这么多年的建设，特别是自己成为半步八劫境后，彻底参悟这方宇宙的十大本源规则时，也为沧元界的神魔修行体系创出了大量的法门，彻底补足了沧元界的短板。
一个中等生命世界，一旦诞生出一位半步八劫境，修行体系会迅速完善。
因为半步八劫境，是掌握最根本的时间、空间，且还会去参悟十大本源规则，掌握这一切根本后……再来推演修行体系，是最符合这方宇宙的修行体系，可比七劫境们创造法门强太多了。像劫境之前的修行体系，孟川能够三五天就创出一门。连劫境层次的法门，他都创出了三十门。
“若是渡劫成功，我也会为沧元界神魔修行体系，创出一门不亚于星空一脉、修罗一脉的完善法门。”孟川想道。
他如今境界都足够，阅读过书山，吸收混沌领主‘智者’的记忆后，积累也足够，但时间不够了。
仅仅二十年时间，创造星空一脉这层次的强大法门，太紧张了。
“沧元界。”
孟川飞行在沧元界一处处区域。
同妖族的战争正式结束已过去一千六百多年了，对如今沧元界的老百姓们而言，妖族？仅仅是史书上的记载，太遥远了。
整个沧元界如今是有史以来最繁荣时期，孟川作为这个时代时空长河最强者，给沧元界带来太多好处，大量奇珍异宝、典籍都运送到沧元界，沧元界的普通老百姓们都能接触到修行，修行成为每一个沧元界族人必定要做的事，只是成‘神魔’比例依旧极低极低。
可诞生的神魔，也比一千多年前，多太多了。
毕竟是诞生过八劫境生命体的家乡世界，这样的世界，在时空长河也都是无比繁荣的，仅次于高等生命世界。
“蒙刹界。”孟川想到了蒙刹界。
蒙刹之祖，也是成为八劫境生命体，只是渡劫失败了。
他留给蒙刹界的宝藏，反而引来了万星天帝的窥伺。
“福祸相依。”
content_en:
"Go through the tribulation well. After surviving the eighth heavenly tribulation, your lifespan will be greatly increased, and you will be able to see scenery thousands of times more wonderful." Brother Qianju grinned, "Otherwise, you can only live in a short period of hundreds of thousands of years and experience only one universe. Your experience will be too little."
Meng Chuan does not think that the Seven Tribulations Realm is already at the pinnacle of the universe and has gained enough.
It's just that in comparison, the experience of jumping out of the Eight Tribulations Realm of the long river of time and space is incredible.
"Your test has been completed. You can't stay here for too long. It's time to leave." Senior Brother Qianju said, "If you want to see Master in the future, just go directly to Qingshan Mountain."
"Senior Brother Qianju, I'll take my leave then." Meng Chuan said.
Brother Qianju nodded.
Meng Chuan's body disappeared.
"Ugh."
Senior Brother Qian Shu was elated, "I'm the only one left in Qianyuan Mountain again, and all the troublemakers are gone."
Brother Qianju lay down happily on the spot, hugging himself with six paws, touching his face with two paws, and began to fall asleep again, naturally creating the world he wanted to experience in his dreams. As a Qianju Senior Brother who possesses the ultimate strength of the Eight Tribulations Realm, the world created by dreams is comparable to the real world.
Over the long years, he has long been accustomed to "doing whatever he wants" in dream worlds. He only wakes up once in a while when he has to receive Master's disciples.
…
In Cangyuan Realm, in the Great Hall of Heaven and Earth, Meng Chuan also had a flame mark between his eyebrows. With a thought, the mark was hidden.
The soul clone far away in Qianyuan Mountain is gone. After all, the soul clone does not have any treasures. The talents, memories obtained in Qianyuan Mountain, and the true identity clone in the home universe are all obtained. There is no need to travel hard anymore.
"There are still twenty years left before the tribulation." Meng Chuan walked out of the Great Hall of Heaven and Earth. "Now all the clones have returned to their home universe. They can control the flow of time and protect their hometown for another two hundred years."
It seems to be the same as others, but Meng Chuan's own time flow rate is one-tenth that of the outside world.
In this way, the natural disaster will come two hundred years later in the home universe.
Meng Chuan just wanted to protect his hometown and spend more time with his family.
"Huh."
High in the sky at the beginning of the Yuan Dynasty, Meng Chuan overlooked the entire sect.
After so many years of construction, especially after he became the Half-Step Eight Tribulations Realm and fully understood the ten original rules of this universe, he also created a large number of methods for the god and demon cultivation system in the Cangyuan Realm, completely making up for the shortcomings of the Cangyuan Realm.
In a medium life world, once a half-step eight calamity realm is born, the practice system will be quickly improved.
Because in the Half-Step Eight Tribulations Realm, you have to master the most fundamental time and space, and you will also understand the ten original rules. After mastering all these fundamentals... and then deduce the practice system, it is the most suitable practice system for this universe, and it is much better than the creative methods of the Seven Tribulations Realm. Like the practice system before the Tribulation Realm, Meng Chuan was able to create one in three to five days. He has even created thirty Dharma doors at the Tribulation Realm level.
"If I succeed in overcoming the tribulation, I will also create a perfect method for the cultivation system of gods and demons in Cangyuan Realm that is no less than that of the Starry Sky Lineage and the Shura Lineage." Meng Chuan thought.
He has enough realm now. After reading the mountain of books and absorbing the memories of the Chaos Lord ‘Wise Man’, he has accumulated enough, but he doesn’t have enough time.
It was too stressful to create a powerful method at the level of the Starry Sky Lineage in just twenty years.
"Cangyuan Realm."
Meng Chuan flew in various areas of Cangyuan Realm.
It has been more than 1,600 years since the war with the demon clan officially ended. To the people of Cangyuan Realm today, the demon clan? It's just a record in history books, it's too far away.
The entire Cangyuan world is now in its most prosperous period in history. Meng Chuan, as the most powerful person in the time and space of this era, has brought many benefits to the Cangyuan world. A large number of rare treasures and classics have been transported to the Cangyuan world. Ordinary people in the Cangyuan world can have access to practice. Cultivation has become something that every clan member of the Cangyuan world must do. However, the proportion of becoming 'gods and demons' is still extremely low.
But there are far more gods and demons born than there were a thousand years ago.
After all, it is the home world where life forms of the Eight Tribulations Realm have been born. Such a world has been extremely prosperous in the long river of time and space, second only to the world of higher life forms.
"Mengsha Realm." Meng Chuan thought of Mengsha Realm.
The ancestor of Mengsha also became a life form in the Eight Tribulations Realm, but failed to transcend the tribulations.
The treasure he left to the Mengsha Realm attracted the prying eyes of the Ten Thousand Stars Emperor.
“Blessings and misfortunes depend on each other.”
title_en: Episode 29 Chapter 13 Meng Chuan and Meng Yu Episode 29 Chapter 12 Pass the test
